items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: The interviewee never mentions Buck Johnson directly; the mention occurs only in the interviewer's turn ('I know Buck Johnson used to talk about him'), and the interviewee does not confirm any personal connection or relationship with Buck Johnson.

ctx.x: Another, another name, uh, Olivia. Yeah.
It was Adam Olivier, from uptown. Olivia. Up on Chappapulis. I know Buck Johnson used to talk about him. Olivier. I think he played violin, the, uh, leader. He was a barber too. I can't.
Maybe too many. Olivia. But they had Tony Jackson played piano with him.
